steps.en: All outstanding notices of the ID are put on hold
steps.id: Semua notice outstanding milik ID ditahan

steps.en: Held notices get no reminder at the registered address
steps.id: Notice yang ditahan tidak dapat reminder ke alamat terdaftar

steps.en: New notices under the same ID are also held
steps.id: Notice baru milik ID yang sama juga ditahan
steps.why_en: The automatic jobs that would catch new notices are commented out or switched off in production.
steps.why_id: Job otomatis yang menangkap notice baru dikomentari atau dimatikan di produksi.

steps.en: The hold lasts for a set period
steps.id: Penahanan berlaku untuk jangka waktu tertentu
steps.why_en: Period length is set in data we cannot see, and the hold renews itself until lifted by hand.
steps.why_id: Lama periode ada di data yang tidak terlihat, dan penahanan diperbarui sendiri sampai dicabut manual.
